extra_quotes: Polarization-tunable infrared (IR) pump pulses (1.2 eV, 135 fs,∼0.48 mJ/cm 2) andp-polarized XUV probe pulses (21.6 eV) are focusedin-situonto a freshly cleaved SnSe sample (HQGraphene) at room temperature, inside the interaction chamber of the momentum microscope end station, allowing the measurement of the nonequilibrium electronic structure and occupations.
